claims.claim: End-of-paragraph citation placement was rejected as an AI sign because humans have written that way for two decades.
The Markdown sign was downgraded 2026-08-27 while 'vague expression of connection' (2026-08-19) and 'pro-authoritarian bias' (2026-08-20) were added; a tell list is a dated snapshot.
claims.source: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing — revision history (2026-08-12 to 2026-09-06)

claims.page: Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing — revision history (2026-08-12 to 2026-09-06)

claims.feature: task-specific text is closer to human

claims.quote: detectors struggle with MGT in realistic generation scenarios
claims.page: WETBench 2025 — A Benchmark for Detecting Task-Specific Machine-Generated Text on Wikipedia (arXiv 2507.03373)
